comments.author: @get2dachoppa249
comments.text: This was a good vid.  I've been to Guam 3 times since 2023, really explored it while I was there, really enjoyed it.  Its like Hawaii lite, with Tumon Bay being Waikiki lite.  That time zone thing is really real when you are making any kind of reservation on Guam.  You have to make your reservation for the next day if you are headed west from Honolulu, but its not an issue if you are getting there from Japan or Korea.  Tourism is in serious decline though, as in double digit drops.  I saw it myself between my 2023 & 2025 visits.  2025 was a ghost town compared to 2023.  Lots of tourist based business closed up, including my favorite Hard Rock Cafe worldwide.
